world_situation.energy_chokepoint.name: Global Energy & Chokepoint Shock
world_situation.energy_chokepoint.summar: Disrupted shipping lanes and strategic supply squeezes are rippling through global energy and commodity prices. Convene an emergency summit to restore flows or leverage scarcity for national gain.
world_situation.debt_contagion.name: Sovereign Debt Contagion
world_situation.debt_contagion.summary: Rising sovereign arrears and shaken bond markets threaten a cascade of defaults across interconnected economies. Coordinate a stabilization pact or tighten bilateral leverage.
world_situation.supply_race.name: Semiconductor & Rare-Earth Supply Race
world_situation.supply_race.summary: Major powers are competing fiercely for high-tech supply chains, rare earths, and strategic megaproject inputs. Negotiate open standards or weaponize export choke points.
world_situation.arms_spiral.name: Great-Power Arms Spiral & Détente
world_situation.arms_spiral.summary: Active conflicts and heightened strategic alerts are accelerating global rearmament. Host a security détente conference to cool tensions before an irreversible escalation.
world_situation.autonomy_wave.name: Regional Autonomy & Referendum Wave
world_situation.autonomy_wave.summary: Restive provinces and civic movements are demanding devolution and constitutional bargains across multiple continents. Craft a shared governance charter or back rival factions.
world_situation.reconstruction_charter.s: War-scarred regions urgently require coordinated rebuilding capital, materials, and security guarantees. Lead an international reconstruction charter to shape the post-conflict order.
